scope: Isolated negative controls for the theorem gate. Production mutants change one production Rust body in a staged copy and must fail exactly their named unchanged theorem after fresh extraction. Mathematical mutants change one definition in a staged copy of UsageLaws.lean and must fail exactly their named unchanged law. None is a production mode.

mathematical.exactBefore: if accumulator + value ≤ limit then boundedFold limit (accumulator + value) rest
mathematical.exactAfter: if accumulator + value < limit then boundedFold limit (accumulator + value) rest
